edges.description: Altered alpha-actinin-2 disrupts its structural cross-linking role at the Z-disk, degrading sarcomeric organization.

Missense substitutions, particularly in the actin-binding domain, reduce the solubility and thermal stability of the folded protein. Shown for ACTN2 hypertrophic-cardiomyopathy alleles rather than MPD6 alleles, so the edge is a candidate route for the MPD6 missense class rather than a demonstrated one.
Protein-extending frameshift variants render alpha-actinin-2 aggregation-prone.
Destabilized, poorly incorporated alpha-actinin-2 is left unbound in the cytoplasm where it is free to aggregate.
Aggregated alpha-actinin-2 and increased protein expression disrupt normal Z-line organization.

Progressive myofibrillar breakdown produces the histopathologic and clinical features of the distal myopathy. The distal predilection is not explained by the Z-disk defect alone, which is uniform across striated muscle; see mechanistic_hypotheses#mpd6_eccentric_load_selective_vulnerability.
edges.target: Distal skeletal muscle degeneration and weakness

edges.description: Protein-extending dominant frameshift variants form alpha-actinin-2 aggregates in this system while recessive missense variants do not, which is the direct experimental basis for the aggregation node.
edges.limitations: A murine myoblast line is not adult human skeletal muscle: it lacks the mature sarcomere, the mechanical loading and the decades of exposure under which the human phenotype emerges. The assay scores aggregate formation, not the downstream Z-disk failure or muscle degeneration, and the authors state the mechanism accounts for only a limited number of variants.
edges.source: C2C12 myoblast ACTN2 variant aggregation assay

edges.description: Establishes that a dominant ACTN2 missense allele is sufficient to produce sarcomeric disarray and abnormal Z-lines in vivo, supporting the Z-disk node in this entry.
edges.limitations: p.Leu727Arg is a de novo allele of Multiple structured Core Disease, an allelic congenital ACTN2 myopathy with early-onset weakness and respiratory involvement - not an MPD6 allele. The model is transient overexpression of exogenous human mRNA rather than a knock-in at endogenous dosage, and a larval fish has no adult-onset, anterior-lower-leg selective phenotype to recapitulate. It supports the general Z-disk mechanism, not the MPD6 phenotype.

edges.description: Mutant alpha-actinin-2 expressed in mouse tibialis anterior produces abnormal Z-line organization and cores together with measurable force loss, linking the Z-disk node to a contractile deficit in a mammalian muscle.
edges.limitations: Same allele caveat as the zebrafish arm: p.Leu727Arg causes the allelic congenital core myopathy, not MPD6. Local AAV transduction gives an approximately twofold supraphysiological alpha-actinin-2 level over four weeks, which models acute mutant-protein burden rather than the decades of adult-onset degeneration that define MPD6, and says nothing about why the human disease selects the anterior compartment.
edges.source: AAV2/9 ACTN2 p.Leu727Arg tibialis anterior mouse

nodes.description: Wild-type, mutant or empty AAV2/9 injected into the tibialis anterior of 3-week-old male mice, with in situ force measurement, histochemistry and electron microscopy 4 weeks later. Notably the injected muscle is the tibialis anterior, the muscle that fails first in MPD6.

nodes.description: A candidate step upstream of aggregation, and one of the few leads on the missense class whose mechanism is otherwise undetermined. Systematic biophysical profiling of ACTN2 missense variants shows reduced solubility, reduced thermal and proteolytic stability, and a strong propensity to aggregate in solution, with the actin-binding domain the most vulnerable region. Structural work on actin-binding-domain variants shows the same variants incorporate less well into the Z-disc and that the unincorporated protein forms aggregates outside it. Both lines of evidence come from ACTN2 hypertrophic-cardiomyopathy variant panels rather than MPD6 alleles, so this node states a plausible shared property of destabilizing ACTN2 missense variants, not a demonstrated MPD6 mechanism.
